scripts.build: node scripts/update-index.mjs && license-to-json -output=./src/assets/3d-party-licenses.json && ng build && node scripts/create-app-version.js
scripts.eslint:publish: cd dist\eslint-config && npm publish --access public && cd ..\..
scripts.eslint:bpl: npm run eslint:build && npm run eslint:publish-local
scripts.eslint:bpli-ng: npm run eslint:build && cd ./dist/eslint-config && npm pack && cd ../.. && node scripts/install-eslint-config-local.js
scripts.eslint:bpli: cd ./projects/eslint-config && npm run build && cd ../../dist/eslint-config && npm pack && cd ../.. && node scripts/install-eslint-config-local-dist.js
scripts.eslint:pli: cd ./projects/eslint-config && npm pack && cd ../.. && node scripts/install-eslint-config-local.js
scripts.mantic:publish: cd dist\mantic-ui && npm publish --access public && cd ..\..
scripts.mantic:publish-rc: cd dist\mantic-ui && npm publish --access public --tag rc && cd ..\..
scripts.mantic:bpl: npm run mantic:build && npm run mantic:publish-local
scripts.doc:publish: cd dist\mantic-ui-doc && npm publish --access public && cd ..\..
scripts.doc:publish-rc: cd dist\mantic-ui-doc&& npm publish --access public --tag rc && cd ..\..
scripts.doc:bpl: npm run doc:build && npm run doc:publish-local
scripts.fomantic:publish: cd dist\fomantic-ui && npm publish --access public && cd ..\..
scripts.semantic:publish: cd dist\semantic-ui && npm publish --access public && cd ..\..
scripts.semantic:publish-rc: cd dist\semantic-ui && npm publish --access public --tag rc && cd ..\..
scripts.semantic:bpl: npm run semantic:build && npm run semantic:publish-local
scripts.theme:publish: cd dist\mantic-ui-theme && npm publish --access public && cd ..\..
scripts.theme:publish-rc: cd dist\mantic-ui-theme && npm publish --access public --tag rc && cd ..\..
scripts.theme:bpl: npm run theme:build && npm run theme:publish-local
scripts.update:eslint: ng update angular-eslint --force --allow-dirty && npx npm-check-updates "/typescript-eslint" -u  && npx npm-check-updates "/^eslint/" -u && npm i --force
